effect.name: Krita Additive Subtractive (Background)
effect.description: Subtracts the square root of the lower layer from the upper layer
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Krita Additive Subtractive (Background) Shader | 2026.08.20 */
parameter.description: Subtracts the square root of the lower layer from the upper layer

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be the subtraction. When this value is set to 0 then blend will subtract base and when set to 1 then base will subtract blend.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.
